updates.title: Certain Oil Country Tubular Goods From the United Arab Emirates: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Sales at Less Than Fair Value
updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that certain oil country tubular goods (OCTG) from the United Arab Emirates (UAE) are being, or are likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is April 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

updates.title: Ripe Olives From Spain: Preliminary Results and Partial Rescission of Countervailing Duty Administrative Review; 2024
